description: The FileLog enum manages logging operations, including writing logs to a file with timestamped filenames, outputting log messages to console and file, and handling log file creation and closure. It also provides mechanisms for logging exceptions.

classes.name: FileLog
classes.description: An enum providing logging utilities, managing log files, and outputting logs with timestamps.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes the log file stream if not already opened.

methods.name: openLog
methods.description: Creates or opens the log file, returning a FileOutputStream.

methods.name: createFolderIfNeeded
methods.description: Creates the directory for logs if it does not exist.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Returns the current date formatted as 'yyyy-MM-dd_HH_mm_ss'.

methods.name: logLine
methods.description: Logs a message with a timestamp to console and, if enabled, to the log file.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs an exception's stack trace to the log file.

methods.name: logException
methods.description: Logs a message and an exception's stack trace.
